notablePrerequisites:
Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Zethi.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to cast a copy of Said.
Resolve Said, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Said // Done
uses.cardState: with a kick counter on it
